summary: Cass Information Systems filed an 8-K covering first-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings results disclosed via press release, an investor presentation, and an earnings supplement. The filing also reports that three directors, Ralph W. Clermont, James L. Lindemann, and Sally H. Roth, retired after not standing for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting, with no dispute or disagreement with the company. None of these items constitute a special situation; the earnings release is routine and the director retirements are non-disruptive, not forced CEO/CFO/board departures that are themselves the event. Accordingly, this filing does not fall under any special-situations category.
